name: Twelve Data
tagline: Real-time and historical stock, forex, crypto, and market data API
description: Twelve Data provides market data APIs for stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, ETFs, and more, including real-time quotes, time series, technical indicators, and fundamentals. Developers authenticate with an API key and call REST endpoints for prices, candles, and reference data across global markets.

auth.details: API key via apikey query parameter or Authorization header; self-serve signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: Basic free plan: 8 API credits/min, 800 credits/day; delayed data; endpoints cost 1+ credits by complexity

rate_limits: Per plan in API credits: free Basic 8/min & 800/day; paid tiers scale (e.g. Grow ~55/min, Pro ~610/min, Ultra ~1440/min) — see pricing
use_cases: get real-time stock quote for a ticker
fetch historical OHLCV time series for a symbol
compute technical indicators for a security
list forex or crypto exchange rates
